description: Saves collection counts in one operation. Match every row to a datasheet id with list_units. Use replace false to keep existing counts. Use true only after explicit confirmation to overwrite counts on matching entries. Entries omitted from the import stay in the collection, so imports can be split into batches. Requires mcp:manage.
